name: Outbound Dialer & Campaigns
description: Center-initiated contact system: campaign list management, dialing modes paced to compliance ceilings, agent-assigned outcomes, and WFM-affecting schedule calendars.
roleInCenter: Outbound engine: reaches customers deliberately, inside regulatory windows, with auditable outcomes.

glossary.definition: Managed outreach effort with target list, offer or message, and success criteria
Pacing strategy that determines call placement rate and agent readiness model
Algorithm dials ahead of agent availability based on answer-rate prediction
Regulatory maximum share of answered-by-customer calls with no agent connected
Segmentation, DNC suppression, best-time filters, and penetration caps per record
Suppression regime: internal DNC plus registry checks before dial
Permitted contact hours by jurisdiction and consent type
Attempt reached the intended person; denominator for conversion metrics
Share of list records with a definitive outcome (contact, refusal, bad number)
Planned outbound volume events WFM must forecast for

children.name: Manual Preview
children.description: Agent reviews record and clicks to dial

children.name: Progressive
children.description: System dials one call per agent as they become available

children.name: Predictive
children.description: Paces ahead of availability; must respect abandoned ceiling

children.name: Voice Broadcast / Message Drop
children.description: No live agent; answer plays prerecorded message

children.name: Service Notification
children.description: Outage, delivery, fraud alerts with opt-out handling

children.name: DNC Suppression & Consent Basis
children.description: Reason recorded for each contact attempt

children.name: Opt-Out Handler
children.description: Immediate suppression and CRM consent write-back

metrics.name: Right-Party Contact Rate
metrics.definition: Attempts reaching intended party over dial attempts

metrics.name: Campaign Conversion
metrics.definition: Successful outcomes per right-party contact (sale, promise, saved customer)

metrics.name: Outbound Abandoned Share
metrics.definition: Customer-answered calls with no connected agent over ceiling baseline

metrics.name: Cost per Contact
metrics.definition: Fully loaded campaign cost over completed right-party contacts

metrics.name: Attempted Volume
metrics.definition: Total dial attempts in period; feeds inbound-after-outbound repeat wave forecasting

failureModes.name: Pacing Overrun
failureModes.signal: Abandon ceiling approached in specific intervals; regulator exposure grows
failureModes.mitigation: Auto-throttle and per-mode ceiling alarms in dialer config

failureModes.name: Consent Basis Gap
failureModes.signal: Audit finds contacts without recallable consent or business relationship
failureModes.mitigation: No dial without consent tag; CRM consent state is the gate

failureModes.name: Outbound Echo Wave
failureModes.signal: Inbound volume spikes 24-72h after campaign waves; WFM understaffed
failureModes.mitigation: Campaign calendar informs forecast; response-wave factor applied

failureModes.name: List Decay
failureModes.signal: Bad-number and wrong-party rates climbing as list ages
failureModes.mitigation: Penetration caps; auto-suspend records after N bad outcomes

scoringModel.name: Outbound Pacing & Regulatory Governance Scorecard
scoringModel.note: Evaluates outbound campaign execution across regulatory compliance, predictive pacing stability, right-party contact hygiene, and cross-channel suppression integrity.

dimensions.name: Regulatory & Consent Compliance
dimensions.description: Strict enforcement of DNC registries, verified consent basis, jurisdictional calling windows, and mandatory opening disclosures
sampleCriteria: Pre-dial DNC and consent token verified against CRM state
Attempt placed strictly inside recipient local permitted calling window
Mandatory recording and identity disclosures delivered verbatim

dimensions.name: Predictive Pacing & Abandon Ceiling Control
dimensions.description: Real-time dialer pacing accuracy keeping customer-answered abandoned share safely below the 3 percent regulatory ceiling while maintaining agent utilization
sampleCriteria: Rolling interval abandonment rate maintained below 3 percent threshold
Auto-throttle triggered immediately when answer-rate variance spikes
Zero dead-air connect delays exceeding 2 seconds from customer hello

dimensions.name: Right-Party Contact & Outcome Execution
dimensions.description: Accurate right-party verification, value-aligned offer or recovery presentation, and definitive disposition logging
sampleCriteria: Right-party identity confirmed prior to account-specific discussion
Campaign offer or resolution path tailored to customer segment
Accurate outcome disposition and promise-to-pay or opt-out logged in CRM

dimensions.name: List Saturation & Cross-Channel Suppression
dimensions.description: Penetration cap discipline, active incident suppression, and WFM inbound echo-wave coordination
sampleCriteria: Daily and weekly dial attempt caps respected per customer record
Commercial outreach suppressed during active service escalations
Campaign wave volume synchronized with WFM inbound echo forecast

exchanges: Consent and suppression states gate dialing
Attempt and outcome write-back to record
Campaign calendar as forecast event feed
Voice broadcast content and opt-out self-service paths
Outbound-specific compliance disclosures in evaluation rubric

stateVariables.description: Continuous stochastic predictive dialer placement rate dynamically modulated by agent readiness density and real-time answer propensity
Filtered customer-answered abandonment ratio constrained strictly below the 0.03 TCPA regulatory ceiling via barrier control
Time-of-day and channel-conditioned instantaneous hazard rate of achieving a Right-Party Contact for record profile x at local time t
Remaining viable contactable fraction of the campaign list decaying under cumulative dial penetration, opt-outs, and bad-number discovery
Cross-channel suppression damping field integrating recent digital touches, open support incidents, and DNC revocations to mute dial eligibility

differentialEquations.name: TCPA-Constrained Predictive Pacing Control SDE
differentialEquations.formula: d_lambda_dial(t) = kappa_pace * ( N_idle(t) * inv(p_ans(t)) - lambda_dial(t) ) * dt - gamma_tcpa * (0.03 - A_abn(t))^(-2) * dt + sigma_pace * dW_t
differentialEquations.interpretation: Drives dial rate lambda_dial(t) toward expected agent capacity N_idle(t) * inv(p_ans(t)) while a reciprocal control barrier (0.03 - A_abn(t))^(-2) enforces hard asymptotic throttling before the 3 percent abandonment ceiling is breached

differentialEquations.name: List Saturation Decay & RPC Propensity Evolution
differentialEquations.formula: dS_list(t) * inv(dt) = -lambda_dial(t) * ( h_rpc(x, t) + mu_bad(t) + mu_optout(t) ) * S_list(t) * (1 - Psi_supp(t))
differentialEquations.interpretation: Models the continuous depletion of viable list inventory S_list(t) as records convert via right-party contact hazard h_rpc(x, t) or exit via wrong-party and opt-out rates, scaled by active suppression (1 - Psi_supp(t))

differentialEquations.name: Cross-Channel Suppression Damping Field Equation
differentialEquations.formula: dPsi_supp(t) * inv(dt) = -alpha_cool * Psi_supp(t) + beta_touch * (1 - Psi_supp(t)) * ( I_inbound(t) + I_digital(t) ) + M_dnc * I_revoke(t)
differentialEquations.interpretation: Integrates inbound service contacts I_inbound(t), digital nudges I_digital(t), and permanent consent revocations I_revoke(t) into a damping field Psi_supp(t) that prevents over-contacting and regulatory violations

scaleInvariants: Zero-breach TCPA barrier invariant: P(A_abn(t) >= 0.03) -> 0 across arbitrary answer-rate non-stationarity via control barrier damping
Idempotent DNC and consent revocation gate: any opt-out event forces (1 - Psi_supp(t)) = 0 within sub-second propagation across all dialer nodes
Outbound-to-inbound echo conservation: integral of campaign attempts lambda_dial(t) dt maps linearly via response-wave convolution kernel to WFM inbound forecast demand
